decisions.reason: Positive identity/structure/exit assessment with material caveats: Ethereum token and registered redemption vault are matched by official sources and read-only calls. The euro-denominated Fasanara credit exposure and issuer-operated standard/capacity-limited instant redemption are documented. Approval does not imply guaranteed liquidity, principal protection or eligibility for every holder.

Insufficient verified exit evidence for this Monad representation: PT redemption returns SY/Monad USDat, while issuer documentation specifies Ethereum redemption routes. A usable Monad-local or supported cross-chain issuer exit and the associated controls were not established. This is an evidence-based exclusion, not a finding of fraud.
